name: ChoreFace_CallSavedHook

name: rdCache_DrawNGonTFATThunk
comment: Passes its stack arguments on to rdNRaster_DrawNGonTFAT and returns 1. Nothing references it (dead code); was FUN_00408800.

name: rdFace_NewEntry
comment: Resets a 0x4c-byte face record (rdFace_NewEntry of the Jedi Knight RDroid library): type, geometry / lighting / texture modes, material and the vertex lists 0, material index (+0x24) -1. Called by rdModel3_LoadEntryText for every face it reads; was FUN_00450220.

name: Res_SysInitializeBody
comment: The body of Res_SysInitialize (0x00480010 loads its arguments into ECX / EDX and falls through to here): stores the low-level services, and on the first call (EDX 0) fills the SysModuleIface with the Res_Sys* entry points and clears the resource lists. Returns 0, or 1 when called again; was FUN_00480020.

name: Render_CompareDrawDepth
comment: qsort comparator of Render_BuildActorDrawList: 1 when the depth (+4) of the first entry is less than the second's, else 0; was FUN_004862b0.

name: stdDisplay_EnumDevicesCallback
comment: DirectDrawEnumerate callback (guid, description, driver name, context): fills display device record g_dwStdDisplay_numDevices (at most 16, 0x298 bytes each). Hand-written in build/overrides_asm_o2.c; was FUN_004761b0.

name: rdRaster_EdgeStepLight
comment: Edge step of the non-z-buffered Gouraud polygons: rdAFRaster_SetupEdgeNGonGS steps both edges with it (light per row). Hand-written in build/overrides_asm_q6.c; was FUN_004104b0.

name: rdRaster_EdgeStepTex
comment: Edge step of the non-z-buffered affine textured polygons (u, v per row): rdAFRaster_SetupEdgeNGonLAT / FAT. Hand-written in build/overrides_asm_q6.c; was FUN_00411b70.

name: rdRaster_EdgeStepTexLight
comment: Edge step of the non-z-buffered affine textured, Gouraud-lit polygons (u, v and light per row): rdAFRaster_SetupEdgeNGonGAT. Hand-written in build/overrides_asm_q6.c; was FUN_004129f0.

name: rdAFRaster_AdvanceLeftEdgeNGonIT
comment: Left edge step of the non-z-buffered perspective textured polygons (rdAFRaster_SetupEdgeNGonLIT / FIT), the counterpart of rdAFRaster_AdvanceLeftEdgeNGonGIT without light. Hand-written in build/overrides_asm_q6.c; was FUN_00415180.

name: rdAFRaster_AdvanceRightEdgeNGonIT
comment: Right edge step of the non-z-buffered perspective textured polygons (rdAFRaster_SetupEdgeNGonLIT / FIT), the counterpart of rdAFRaster_AdvanceRightEdgeNGonGIT without light. Hand-written in build/overrides_asm_q6.c; was FUN_004151c0.

name: LoadBlock
comment: LoadBlock (Lua 3.1 lundump.c): allocates `size` bytes (the host allocator, service +0x20) and reads them from the stream (ezread); was lundump__d030.

name: Undump_InvertBytes
comment: Complements `n` bytes in place (byte-wise up to dword alignment, then dwords): Grim's precompiled scripts store their code inverted; was lundump__d130.

name: Undump_Swap4
comment: Reverses the byte order of the 4 bytes at p (a word of a chunk saved on the other byte order); was lundump__d360.

name: Undump_Swap8
comment: Reverses the byte order of the 8 bytes at p; was lundump__d380.

name: LoadFunctions
comment: LoadFunctions (Lua 3.1 lundump.c): while the next byte is '#' (ID_FUN), reads the constant index and the nested function (LoadFunction) and stores it in the function's constant table; was lundump__d3c0.

name: _fpmath
comment: MSVC C runtime _fpmath: _cfltcvt_init, then the floating-point start-up of the runtime. (Placed with lzio.c by address only.); was lzio__ef20.

name: _cfltcvt_init
comment: MSVC C runtime _cfltcvt_init: fills the floating-point conversion table (_cfltcvt, _cropzeros, _fassign, _forcdecpt, _positive, _cldcvt) that printf / scanf use; was lzio__ef40.

name: LState_CodeLength
comment: Length in bytes of a function's code: walks the opcodes from +2 of the code block (+0x10 of the prototype) by their sizes in g_aOpcodeDirectory (asserting each opcode is in range) up to the end opcode 0, plus the 2-byte header; was lstate__85e0.

name: ImFx_Initialize
comment: Starts the HMI voice-effects library (hmiFXInitSystem with iMUSE_Malloc / iMUSE_Free) and loads the preset library IMUSE.PSL; sets the input and output formats (22050 Hz, 16 bit, mono in, stereo 44100 out). 1 on success (or when already running), 0 on failure; was FUN_10004660.

name: ImFx_SelectPreset
comment: Releases the current voice-effect preset and processes preset `n` (hmiFXPresetProcess); from its chain of effects decides mono or stereo output, locks the preset and returns the channel count (0 when the preset cannot be made); was FUN_10004750.

name: ImFx_Terminate
comment: Stops the HMI voice-effects library: releases the preset, frees the preset library and calls hmiFXUnInitSystem (when ImFx_Initialize ran); was FUN_10004970.

name: Script_Init
comment: Initialises the music script: installs Script_Callback as the trigger callback, takes the local-music flag, sets up the file list (ImInitFilelist) and the two host callbacks, clears the 0xe4 attributes and the current state / sequence / cue point; was FUN_10006360.

name: Script_Terminate
comment: Ends the music script: stops the local music (Script_StopLocalMusic) and clears the state, the attributes, the sequence and the cue point; was FUN_100063d0.

name: Script_Save
comment: Saves the music script state into `buf` (at least 0x39c bytes): state, sequence, cue point, the attributes, then the file list (ImSaveFilelist). Returns the bytes written or -1; was FUN_10006400.

name: Script_Restore
comment: Restores what Script_Save wrote: unloads and closes everything, reads state, sequence, cue point and the attributes, then the file list (ImRestoreFilelist). Returns the bytes read; was FUN_10006470.

name: Script_Update
comment: Dispatcher command 4, once per frame: ends a sequence the trigger callback flagged as ended, and the current sequence when no music stream is playing; then ImFlushSounds. Hand-written in build/overrides_imuse_r1.c (Script_SetSequence takes a register argument); was FUN_100064d0.

name: Script_SetState
comment: Sets the music state by id (-1: only returns it): finds the state record, and unless it is current or a sequence plays, transitions to its file (Script_Trans). Returns the current state's id. Hand-written in build/overrides_imuse_r1.c; was FUN_10006560.

name: Script_NullCallback
comment: Returns 0: passed as the two script callbacks ImInitializeScript takes, and called by the dispatcher; was FUN_100067a0.

name: Script_Attribute
comment: Script attributes: (-1, 0 / 1) pauses / resumes, (-1, -1) clears all; (10000, buf) copies the state and sequence names into buf and returns 0xde; (n < 0xe4, v) sets attribute n to v (unless v is -1) and returns it; was FUN_100067b0.

name: Script_StopLocalMusic
comment: When the music is local (not streamed by the game): stops all sounds, unloads and closes them; was FUN_10007110.

name: Lip_PhonemeAtTime
comment: The phoneme of the lip-sync track of sound `id` (the stream, 10000, or one of the three sound effects) at time t (in 16ths): the entry whose time range holds it, 0x5f (rest) when none does; was FUN_10008c40.

name: Timer_Start
comment: Starts iMUSE's multimedia timer (timeBeginPeriod / timeSetEvent with timer_callback, at least 50 ms resolution) and waits up to 3 x 4 s for its first tick, restarting it when none comes. Returns the tick count, 0 on failure. Hand-written; was FUN_10008ce0.

name: Timer_Stop
comment: Kills the multimedia timer (timeKillEvent / timeEndPeriod) and runs timer_callback once more; was FUN_10008e30.

name: Sounds_FreeAll
comment: Frees the 32 sound slots (their sound data through the host's free) and clears the handle counter and the sound cache; was FUN_10008e60.

name: Sounds_GetSoundAddr
comment: The sound data address of sound slot `id` (100..0x84), 0 otherwise; ihost_get_sound_addr returns it; was FUN_10009530.

name: Sounds_GetMapAddr
comment: The map address of sound slot `id` (100..0x84), 0 otherwise; ihost_get_map_addr returns it; was FUN_10009560.

name: Im_DiscardMessage
comment: An empty printf: stored in a table of message functions; was FUN_10009700.

name: ImList_AddHead
comment: Links `node` (next at +0, previous at +4, both 0: not in a list) in front of the list `*head`. 0, or -5 (logged) when the node is in a list already; was FUN_10004460.

name: ImList_Remove
comment: Unlinks `node` from the list `*head`. 0, -5 for a null node or empty list, -3 when the node is not in the list (both logged); was FUN_100044b0.

name: Sounds_QueryMusicStream
comment: Finds the first music stream (param 0x1800 == 1 with 0x400 == 3 or 4) and queries it (ImQueryStream: buffer size, critical size, free space, paused). 1 when there is one; was FUN_10007700.

name: Sounds_IsMusicCritical
comment: 1 when the music stream plays and its free space is at most its critical size (SoundsFillStreamsWhileMusicCritical loops while it is); was FUN_100076b0.

name: Sounds_IsMusicBufferFull
comment: 0 while the music stream plays and has room for another gulp (free space at most buffer size - gulp size), else 1 (SoundsFloodMusicBuffer loops until it is); was FUN_100077c0.

name: Sounds_MlInit
comment: Allocates the sounds module's list of 20 loaded-memory entries (g_dwMlEntries) and clears it; was FUN_10007a20.

name: Sounds_MlFreeAll
comment: Frees every block in the loaded-memory list and the list itself; was FUN_100081f0.

name: Sounds_MlAdd
comment: Adds a block to the loaded-memory list: appends while there is room, else reuses a free slot or doubles the list; was FUN_10009f40.

name: Sounds_MlRemove
comment: Clears the loaded-memory list's slot that holds `block`; was FUN_1000a030.

name: Sounds_CompareRange
comment: Search comparator: 0 when value lies in [range[0], range[1]), -1 below it, 1 above it; was FUN_10009ef0.
